note: The word "check" belongs to two skills — "check my setup" is the environment, "check this" is the diff — so the first negative is deliberately a prompt built around that shared verb.

positives.prompt: my guardrails do not seem to be firing, work out what is missing
I just cloned this repo — is my environment actually set up to work on it
some tool the hooks depend on is not installed and I cannot tell which, give me the install line
will the pre-commit gate in here really run, or is it silently skipping

negatives.prompt: check over the change I have built so far and tell me if it is sound
negatives.note: Same verb, different object. This is the pair most likely to drift into each other.

negatives.prompt: walk me through what is left on this change
pick the active change back up and build the next unticked task
